name: TFmini-S
description: Small 12 m single-point LiDAR with a 10 cm blind zone, 2° beam and up to 1000 Hz. UART or I2C on a 4-pin cable. A step up from TF-Luna for longer range and outdoor use.

variants.note: JST 1.25 mm 4-pin (Molex 51021-0400): GND, +5V, RXD/SDA, TXD/SCL; 10 cm cable. DFRobot SEN0259, SparkFun SEN-16977, Waveshare 24894.

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: Range 0.1-7 m on 10% reflectivity; the same 12 m / 7 m figures hold in 70 klux ambient light
Default 100 Hz, adjustable 1-1000 Hz (1000/n). UART 115200 baud default; interface switched by command
Needs a tight 5 V ±0.1 V supply, no reverse-polarity or over-voltage protection; 3.3 V LVTTL logic
Average current ~50 mA in short-distance mode, ~140 mA in long-distance mode; peak 200 mA
Also has an I/O (on/off threshold) output mode on the TX line. Operating temperature 0-60 °C, not sealed
